subject: POC access playbook draft + owners / timeline
raw_messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@skywardai.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC access playbook draft + owners / timeline

Jordan — thanks for the call this morning. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (POC access playbook) and a short checklist of infra dependencies. High-level ask: confirm owners and whether the timelines below work for you so we can lock the POC target dates.

Summary / immediate next steps:
- Redwood delivers: MAP draft (attached), peering template, sample IP ranges, SSO checklist. (Owner: Redwood SE)
- Customer delivers: approval from cloud network owner, a test VPC for peering, and confirmation of SSO provider (Okta / AzureAD). (Owner: Skyward network/security)
- Target: POC environment ready for smoke tests by 2026-10-15 (subject to approvals).

POC environment dependencies (short):
1) VPC peering: we need CIDR confirmation and a primary contact who can accept route and security group changes. See peering-template.yml (attached).
2) IP allowlists: provide any egress/public IPs and internal subnet ranges you want Redwood to allow. We will provide recommended lists in network-ips.csv.
3) SSO / SAML: we support Okta and Azure AD. We can generate an SP metadata file and an IdP setup guide — expecting ~3 business days to configure once credentials/test tenant are available.
4) Secrets / KMS: for production, we recommend customer-managed KMS. For POC, we can offer a short-term Redwood-managed key if you prefer faster onboarding; let us know which path you want.

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_v1.pdf, peering-template.yml, network-ips.csv

Please reply with: (a) who will own each item on your side, (b) any blocker for the 10/15 milestone, and (c) an approver name for network changes. Happy to set a 20–30 min follow-up next week to finalize the MAP.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@skywardai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Megan Porter <megan.porter@skywardai.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC access playbook draft + owners / timeline

Thanks Karthik — helpful summary and good notes. Couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- On KMS: for compliance we generally prefer customer-managed keys, but security may allow a temporary vendor-managed key for an internal-only POC if we document access controls. I'll confirm with our SecOps by 9/22.
- SSO: we use Okta. Who from Redwood will need admin access or SAML metadata?
- IP allowlist: can you provide your egress IPs and any NAT gateway ranges now so we can route review?

Megan (cc) will be the network owner; she owns peering in our environment. Megan — can you confirm if a test VPC will be available and the contact who can accept the peering request?

Also, note: we have an internal change freeze on 10/1–10/10 for quarterly release — that may push the earliest acceptance window. If approvals slip, we'll need to adjust the POC readiness target.

Jordan Ellis
VP Product, Skyward AI
j.ellis@skywardai.com
+1 (617) 555-0999

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-16T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC access playbook draft + owners / timeline

Looping in a short internal plan to respond to Jordan.

Proposed internal owners / replies:
- Peering template / IP ranges: Laura (SE) will populate peering-template.yml with Skyward CIDR placeholders and provide network-ips.csv by EOD today.
- SSO / SAML: Laura (SE) will create SP metadata and an Okta quick-start (sso-setup-checklist.md). Estimate 2–3 business days once we have Okta admin/test user.
- KMS options: Ben (manager) suggests we offer Redwood-managed temporary key for the POC (30 days) and document controls; switch to customer-managed KMS for production.
- Timeline: because of Skyward's change freeze 10/1–10/10, propose we update POC readiness target from 2026-10-15 to 2026-10-20 to allow for approvals and verification.

I'll attach the initial peering-template.yml and sso-setup-checklist.md drafts to send to Jordan.

Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@skywardai.com>
Cc: Megan Porter <megan.porter@skywardai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-16T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC access playbook draft + owners / timeline

Jordan / Megan — thanks for the quick turn. Action items and confirmed owners below (finalizing MAP):

Redwood -> deliver by 2026-09-17:
- Updated MAP (redwood_map_draft_v1.pdf) with owners and adjusted dates (Owner: Karthik)
- Peering template + example CIDR/IP list (peering-template.yml, network-ips.csv) (Owner: Laura)
- Okta/SP metadata + SSO checklist (sso-setup-checklist.md) (Owner: Laura)
- Temporary POC KMS offer and security controls doc (Owner: Ben)

Skyward -> confirm by 2026-09-22:
- Network owner and primary contact for peering (Megan)
- Decision on KMS approach (customer-managed vs Redwood temporary) (Jordan / Security)
- Any hard blockers related to the 10/1–10/10 freeze that will push timeline (Jordan)

Tentative revised target: environment ready for smoke tests by 2026-10-20. If Skyward can complete approvals before 9/25 we should keep the earlier check-in for validation.

Proposed short sync: 2026-09-20 10:00 AM ET — 20 min to finalize peering CIDRs and SSO handoff. I'll send a calendar invite if that works.

Links / attachments: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-map-skyward (MAP + assets), HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/5421

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

— Karthik
